description:
Created in 2026 for the HH Sheikh Mohammad Bin Rashid Khuzam exhibition dedicated to His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, commissioned by The Executive Office of the Government of Dubai and presented at the Museum of the Future.

I led the video production end-to-end, covering research, creative development, filming, AI-generated content, archival sourcing, editing, and final delivery.

The video combines original footage, AI-generated sequences, and archival material into a cohesive cinematic presentation created specifically for the exhibition.
